title: Chicago Insider Segway Tour
includes: Helmet, and a bag on your Segway to store personal belongings
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a guardian
All riders must weigh a minimum of 100 pounds and not more then 260 pounds
We operate rain or shine, ponchos will be provided if it rains
Guests must complete our waiver before arrival. Please use this link- https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/jnbll3fksztkfzutdmzhn8/web/
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately and wear comfortable closed toed shoes
All riders must be able to climb and descend stairs without assistance
This activity is not appropriate for pregnant women
Those under the influence of drugs and alcohol will not be allowed to participate, and will not be given a refund
All riders must be able to stand for the duration of their tour
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is a tour like no other! Our newest Segway adventure is completely unique and will cover the good, the bad, the ugly and the totally weird stories of Chicago. We will travel back through the ages as you discover the city through the lens of the Chicago Syndicate, hear the whispers of the city’s elite (or politicians), and be entertained by stories that are rarely told. You’ll think “No, really I never would have known!” Glide around Millennium Park, through the new neighborhood of Lakeshore East, and along the Lakefront as we unveil Chicago’s forgotten past in two hours! Your imagination will come alive as you hear stories of the Chicago Mob, the truth behind the 1968 Democratic National Convention, innovations that changed history, and so much more!
